outline: 引導學生瞭解如何根據不同對象、不同場合、不同時間、不同情境，貼切地使用英語，也概括介紹分析語言溝通所需的概念與工具。
schedule:
Week 01  Introduction 1
Week 02  Yule 1: Definition and background
Week 03  Yule 2: Deixis and distance
Week 04  Yule 3: Reference and inference
Week 05  Yule 4: Presupposition and entailment
Week 06	Yule 5: Cooperation and implication
Week 07	Yule 6: Speech acts and events
Week 08	Yule 7: Politeness and interaction
Week 09	Yule 8: Conversation and preference structure
Week 10  Yule 9:Discourse and culture +
(Presentation) "You Think I'm Stupid? Face Needs in Intercultural Conflict"
Week 11  (Presentation)  "Facework in Intercultural E-mail Communication" + Peccei 1: What is Pragmatics
Week 12  (Presentation) Peccei 2: Entailment
Week 13  (Presentation) Peccei 3: Presuppositon
Week 14  (Presentation) Peccei 4: The co-operative principle and implicature
Week 15  (Presentation) Peccei 5: More on implicatures
Week 16  (Presentation) Peccei 6: Speech acts
Week 17  (Presentation) Peccei 7: More about speech acts
Week 18	(Presentation) Peccei 8: Politeness
